summary: Frontend-only UI refinement pass verified on Expo web preview (390x844 mobile viewport). All 11 requested refinement behaviors PASSED: (1) BEFORE YOU GO section label rendered uppercase; (2) 'Leaving around 8:30' semibold context title; (3) 'N left' count correctly shows incomplete-only (4→3 on toggle, back to 4 on uncheck); (4) completed items styled with FILLED accent checkbox + lighter secondary text and textDecoration:'none' (no strikethrough), and reorder BELOW incomplete (verified via Y-position); (5) all-set-state appears when all items done, disappears on uncheck; (6) Quick Add duplicate ('Charger') shows quick-add-dup-message 'Already on your list' and keeps sheet open with no duplicate added; (7) Home frequent-chip duplicate ('Charger') shows home-toast 'Already on your list' with no duplicate; (8) new unique item 'Passport' adds once, count increments to 5 left; (9) Flow E — Settings→Routines→School→Use routine adds Laptop while skipping duplicate Charger/Student ID; (10) Forgot screen: forgot-always-remind DOES NOT exist (0 nodes), forgot-input+forgot-add produces forgot-saved-state with 'Saved / We\u2019ll remind you next time' and only forgot-done action; (11) Trigger flow (Quick Add→remind-choose→trigger screen) toggles trigger-leaving/trigger-time/trigger-arriving; (12) First-launch persistence — after Get started, reload skips onboarding and lands on /home. One pre-existing non-blocking RN-web deprecation warning ('props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents') observed, same as iteration_1.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking; carried over from iteration_1. Likely from Toast/BottomSheet or Reanimated view still passing pointerEvents as prop.

action_items: Optional cleanup: replace `pointerEvents="none"` prop usages with `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` (e.g. src/components/Toast.tsx line 35) to silence the react-native-web deprecation warning.
No functional fixes required — every requested refinement behaves exactly as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: home.tsx: `remaining = items.filter(!done).length` and `sorted = [...incomplete, ...complete]` correctly implement 'N left' and reorder. `allDone` guarded with `items.length > 0` avoids showing All Set on empty state — good.

store.tsx `addItem`: uses trimmed + case-insensitive comparison and returns boolean; both Quick Add and Home chip correctly branch on the return value. Duplicate check reads via `stateRef.current` — safe against stale closures.
ChecklistItem.tsx: no `textDecorationLine` on labelDone — matches the refinement requirement of no strikethrough (verified via computed style).
forgot.tsx: 'Always remind me' UI fully removed; saved state contains only Done PrimaryButton — matches spec.
Toast.tsx: uses `pointerEvents="none"` as prop (line 35) — triggers RN-web deprecation warning. Move onto `style.pointerEvents`.
seed_data_creation: None — cleared localStorage once to re-run onboarding; all other state reached via in-app interactions.
